description: Client-side script for the Landed Cost Voucher doctype in ERPNext, managing setup, data fetching, calculations, and UI interactions.

classes.name: LandedCostVoucher
classes.description: Class managing the Landed Cost Voucher form, including setup, data fetching, calculations, and UI updates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the form, sets up query filters for purchase receipts, and fetches related data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Displays help content and updates currency labels based on the selected company.

methods.name: get_items_from_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Fetches items from selected purchase receipts.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Recalculates total taxes and charges and applicable charges for items.

methods.name: set_total_taxes_and_charges
methods.description: Calculates and sets the total taxes and charges.

methods.name: set_applicable_charges_for_item
methods.description: Distributes charges proportionally among items based on selected criteria.

methods.name: distribute_charges_based_on
methods.description: Triggers recalculation of applicable charges based on distribution method.

methods.name: items_remove
methods.description: Handles removal of items and updates applicable charges accordingly.
